final_message:
`OrderPlaced` now carries both name sets, so the two ARCH-4 failures should clear. I couldn't run ARCH-4 itself (it isn't in this repo), so that is unconfirmed until CI reruns. Locally, the 39 tests pass, typecheck is clean, and `npm run arch` finds no dependency violations.

The event now has `amountCents` and `createdAt`, plus `totalCents` and `placedAt` with the same values. The old two are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`. The event test in `test/app.test.ts` asserts all four fields.

This is a compromise. The old names stay in the event until billing-service and analytics-ingest read `amountCents` and `createdAt`. After that, delete the two deprecated fields and their assignments in `orderPlaced()`. Those two repos are read-only for me, so their teams need to make the change.

If you'd rather have a clean rename, that has to start in those two repos, and CI will keep failing until they ship.
ticket_text: The OrderPlaced event should use the same naming as the Payments and Customer APIs. Rename totalCents to amountCents and placedAt to createdAt.
